name: AWS Cost Explorer - Operations
description: This dashboard provides detailed information about cost and usage by operations performed by various Services in AWS accounts.
title: AWS Cost Explorer - Operations

queries.queryString:
account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where region matches "{{region}}" and Service matches "{{service}}" and operation matches "{{operation}}" and MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Daily"
| timeslice 1d
| last(CostUsd) as total_cost by _timeslice, account, region, CostType, Metrictype, Granularity, Estimated, service, operation
| sum(total_cost) as total_cost by _timeslice, Operation, Estimated
| if (Estimated matches "true" ,"Estimated","Actual") as Estimated
| transpose row _timeslice column Operation, Estimated

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where region matches "{{region}}" and Service matches "{{service}}" and operation matches "{{operation}}" and MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Daily"
| last(CostUsd) as total_cost by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, Service, Operation
| sum(total_cost) as total_cost by StartDate
| sort by StartDate asc

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where region matches "{{region}}" and Service matches "{{service}}" and operation matches "{{operation}}" and MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Daily"
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, Service, Operation
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by Operation
| sort by total_cost, Operation asc

panels.title: Top 10 Operations by Cost Change in Weekly Costs

queries.queryString:
account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Daily
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and region matches "{{region}}" and Service matches "{{service}}" and operation matches "{{operation}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Daily" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Daily"
| first(CostUsd) as current, last(CostUsd) as last_week by account, region, Service, Operation, Estimated
| sum(current) as current,sum(last_week) as last_week by Operation
| (current-last_week)*100/last_week as Percentage_spike 
| where Percentage_spike !=0
| fields Operation, Percentage_spike
| sort by Percentage_spike
| limit 10

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Monthly
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and region matches "{{region}}" and Service matches "{{service}}" and operation matches "{{operation}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Monthly" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Monthly"
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, Service, Operation
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by Service
| sort by total_cost, Service
| limit 10

account={{account}} region CostUsd CostType StartDate EndDate MetricType Granularity Service Operation Monthly
| json "region", "CostUsd", "CostType", "StartDate", "EndDate", "MetricType", "Granularity", "Estimated", "Service", "Operation"
| where MetricType matches "{{MetricType}}" and region matches "{{region}}" and Service matches "{{service}}" and operation matches "{{operation}}" and estimated matches "{{estimated}}"
| where Granularity = "Monthly" and CostType = "cost_service_operation_region_{{MetricType}}_Monthly"
| last(CostUsd) as CostUsd by StartDate, EndDate, account, region, CostType, MetricType, Granularity, Estimated, Service, Operation
| sum(CostUsd) as total_cost by Operation
| sort by total_cost, Operation
| limit 10

panels.title: Note
panels.text:
## Note
* MetricType
  * Refer [AWS cost cheatsheet](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws-cloud-financial-management/understanding-your-aws-cost-datasets-a-cheat-sheet)
* Estimated
  * Use **true** to monitor estimated / forecasted cost. 
  * Use **false** to monitor actual cost. Actual cost is available once in a month after invoice is generated.
* It can take up to 48 hours for [AWS](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cost-management/latest/userguide/ce-what-is.html) to generate your billing data. For accuracy Sumo Logic does not present any billing analysis for the last 48-60 hours.

sourceDefinition.query: account=* region CostUsd CostType MetricType Granularity | count by account

account=* region CostUsd CostType MetricType Granularity
| json "region" 
| count by region
| sort by region asc

account=* region CostUsd CostType MetricType Granularity Service
| json "Service"
| count by service

account=* region CostUsd CostType MetricType Granularity Operation
| json "Operation"
| count by operation
